name: Longmire
description: A Wyoming sheriff rebuilds his life and career following the death of his wife. Based on the “Walt Longmire” series of mystery novels written by best-selling author Craig Johnson.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: With the help of Vic and Henry, Longmire investigates a backcountry murder with ties to a tribal family.

videos.title: The Dark Road
videos.overview: Longmire and his team investigate the death of an exotic dancer with possible Amish roots. Cady's new relationship stirs up controversy.

videos.title: A Damn Shame
videos.overview: Longmire uncovers long-buried family secrets when he probes the deaths of a man and his award-winning horses in a barn fire.

videos.title: The Cancer
videos.overview: A fisherman discovers the bodies of two murder victims, including a teen from the Cheyenne reservation.

videos.title: Dog Soldier
videos.overview: Walt and the team look into the disappearances of several Cheyenne foster children and an unregistered sex offender.

videos.title: The Worst Kind of Hunter
videos.overview: Walt suspects a bear was baited to fatally attack a released murderer. Branch's retired uncle, a former sheriff, can't resist the lure of law enforcement.

videos.title: 8 Seconds
videos.overview: A wealthy beer distributor is brutally assaulted for a seemingly worthless painting; Vic's husband is jealous of her relationship with Walt; Branch's father uncovers information damaging to Walt's campaign.

videos.title: An Incredibly Beautiful Thing
videos.overview: Henry uses his tracking abilities to locate an unstable young woman who may be involved in the murder of a gas-station owner.

videos.title: Dogs, Horses and Indians
videos.overview: The Tribal Council president is found dead on county land but it s clear he died elsewhere and there is soon a large suspect list. Walt deals with feelings of betrayal when he uncovers Cady and Branch s affair.

videos.title: Unfinished Business
videos.overview: In the first-season finale, a teen is murdered after being acquitted of raping a Cheyenne girl. Later, Walt is forced to finally confront his wife’s death.

videos.title: Unquiet Mind
videos.overview: A prison transfer goes awry and Walt urgently pursues a serial killer and his fellow escapees, who have taken hostages, up a mountain. Facing an impending storm with very limited resources, Walt’s mettle is put to the test and hypothermic hallucinations force him to face his past.

videos.title: Carcasses
videos.overview: When a body is found in a compost heap, the victim's history of abusive behavior leads to a varied list of suspects. Walt and the team must cross county lines to track down the killer. Branch looks into Cady's abrupt departure from Absaroka.

videos.title: Death Came in Like Thunder
videos.overview: Walt and the team explore Absaroka's Basque community when a shepherd and his dog are found dead. Branch walks a thin line in his alliance with Jacob Nighthorse. Meanwhile, Cady looks to Detective Fales for answers about her mother's death.

videos.title: The Road to Hell
videos.overview: A cattle heist sends the team on an urgent search for the missing livestock and driver as well as the thieves. Walt is concerned by Vic's fearful behavior when she receives a mysterious bouquet of flowers.

videos.title: Party's Over
videos.overview: When a teenage girl is found dead, Walt and the team investigate ties to the illegal sale of prescription drugs. Meanwhile Henry reconnects with an old flame and Cady returns home.

videos.title: Tell It Slant
videos.overview: Walt is tipped off to the murder of a supposed psychic by the Contrary Warrior, a Cheyenne who does the opposite of what people expect. While deciphering his backwards clues, Walt must also deal with a public debate against Branch.

videos.title: Sound and Fury
videos.overview: After Henry overhears a disgruntled husband try to order a hit on his wife, Walt and the team must use what little information they have to prevent her murder. Vic is wary when an ex-cop from Philly shows up in Durant.

videos.title: The Great Spirit
videos.overview: When a wild horse is found dragging a dead body, Walt discovers evidence of an illegal rodeo at a local farm. Detective Fales comes to town to talk to Henry.

videos.title: Tuscan Red
videos.overview: Following an explosion on the reservation and the discovery of a charred dead body, Walt is bombarded with public confrontation as the Cheyennes blame the blast on gas leaked from fracking by Newett Energy. Meanwhile, Branch reconnects with Cady and uncovers information that could help him in the election.

videos.title: Election Day
videos.overview: On election day, Walt and Branch aren't thinking about politics when Cady is badly injured by a hit-and-run driver. Vic and Ferg investigate, and Walt has a flashback to when Cady was a little girl.

videos.title: Natural Order
videos.overview: When a game warden is killed alongside an elk that was poached, Walt discovers a connection to a rare expensive supplement. Walt completes his sacrifice, and Branch closes in on the truth about Cady's accident.

videos.title: A Good Death Is Hard to Find
videos.overview: Longmire investigates after he receives a safe deposit box from a just-murdered inmate that contains a severed finger that is linked to both a new murder and a 20-year-old armed robbery. At the same time, Vic's paranoia peaks when she suspects she is being stalked, forcing her to confide in Walt.

videos.title: Bad Medicine
videos.overview: Walt and Branch team up when an apparent suicide is connected to Cady's accident. Meanwhile, Detective Fales returns with warrants, forcing Walt and Henry to face what happened in Denver.

videos.title: The White Warrior
videos.overview: Walt deals with the aftermath of Henry's arrest and Branch's shooting.The search for the shooter, however, is complicated by Branch's insistence that it was someone known to be already dead.

videos.title: Of Children and Travelers
videos.overview: An investigation into the murder of a Russian adoptee leads the team into a shady underworld. Henry faces trouble behind bars while Cady attempts to secure him competent legal representation.

videos.title: Miss Cheyenne
videos.overview: Walt splits his time working on a murder investigation and serving as a judge for a local pageant. Cady hopes an old friend can help with Henry's case.

videos.title: In the Pines
videos.overview: Walt and the team track missing teenage campers on a leadership trip in the wilderness. Branch continues his unauthorized search for his shooter.

videos.title: Wanted Man
videos.overview: Walt teams up with Lucian Connally to narrow the field of suspects in his wife's murder. Branch's behavior causes problems.

videos.title: Reports of My Death
videos.overview: A media frenzy erupts when a long-lost heir who went missing 30 years earlier is found dead. Henry makes a risky decision on his own.

videos.title: Population 25
videos.overview: Vic's vacation turns deadly after she and Sean are kidnapped following an accident. Walt is forced to make an unusual alliance to rescue the pair.

videos.title: Harvest
videos.overview: A life insurance policy complicates the investigation into a farmer's apparent murder. Branch and Cady check out a lead in Denver. Vic receives an ultimatum from Sean.

videos.title: Counting Coup
videos.overview: Walt is seriously concerned by Branch's behavior, but makes a key discovery in the David Ridges case. Henry faces a major setback in his trial. Vic makes an important decision about her future.

videos.title: Ashes to Ashes
videos.overview: Walt seeks closure in his wife's murder and Henry's case. Branch is suspended but continues to investigate Jacob Nighthorse.

videos.title: Down by the River
videos.overview: The team struggles with the fallout from Branch's confrontation with Barlow, and Walt's crusade to bring Nighthorse to justice spins out of control.

videos.title: War Eagle
videos.overview: Walt is forced to split his focus between new evidence in a personal case, and the murder of a caretaker at a former Japanese internment camp.

videos.title: High Noon
videos.overview: The investigation of Nighthorse heats up, but not in the way that Walt was hoping for. Cady makes a shocking discovery.

videos.title: Four Arrows
videos.overview: A body found in the luggage of a tour bus further complicates Walt's troubles with Nighthorse. Henry makes a bold move to help a mother and son.

videos.title: Help Wanted
videos.overview: When the husband of a former soldier is assaulted during an apparent robbery, Walt is drawn into an emotionally charged investigation.

videos.title: The Calling Back
videos.overview: A young Native American girl is raped on the reservation, which sparks new, volatile tensions between local oil rig workers and the Cheyenne people.

videos.title: Highway Robbery
videos.overview: A highway robbery sets off an investigation into a strange relationship, while Walt struggles to let go of the past.

videos.title: Hector Lives
videos.overview: When a former suspect in a rape case ends up dead in another county, Walt and Vic aren't convinced the death is an accident.

videos.title: Shotgun
videos.overview: Henry's attempt at justice backfires, resulting in new problems for him and a new investigation for Walt.

videos.title: What Happens on the Rez...
videos.overview: The line between justice and the law gets even blurrier for Henry and Walt as their hunt for a killer intensifies.

videos.title: A Fog That Won't Lift
videos.overview: A shaky Walt searches for Donna as he and Vic reconstruct what happened in the cabin. Mathias has a deal for Henry. Cady tells Walt about a job offer.

videos.title: One Good Memory
videos.overview: Henry renegotiates his deal with Mathias. Walt's search for Donna leads to too many suspects. A phone message sends Walt down an unexpected path.

videos.title: Chrysalis
videos.overview: Walt unravels the puzzling case of a girl and her missing father. Henry helps Cady find a place on the rez. Malachi and Jacob's alliance is weakening.

videos.title: The Judas Wolf
videos.overview: Walt and Vic investigate the bizarre kidnapping of a despised drug company CEO. Henry and Mathias deal with the ramifications of an overdose.

videos.title: Pure Peckinpah
videos.overview: Mathias must join forces with Walt after Henry discovers a drug dealer's body. Vic solves her housing problem. Malachi puts a bounty on Hector's head.

videos.title: Objection
videos.overview: Depositions for Walt's case go badly. Ferg loses confidence in himself. Henry and Vic help lead Walt toward the big boss at Manifest Destinations.

videos.title: From This Day Forward
videos.overview: When treasure hunters discover a body in a hollow tree, Walt finds a connection to an old case. Cady struggles to help a battered woman on the rez.

videos.title: Stand Your Ground
videos.overview: Walt looks deeper into the Irish mob. Henry finds the book he needs, while Cady gets legal advice. Malachi and Jacob lob accusations at each other.

videos.title: Continual Soiree
videos.overview: Walt's obsession with Jacob leads to more tension with Cady. Vic testifies against Gilbert. Walt's anger erupts at the Red Pony.

videos.title: The Stuff Dreams Are Made Of
videos.overview: Walt gets more bad news from the mayor. Vic does a strange favor. As Walt learns what's behind the lawsuit, Henry and Cady each face tribal rituals.

videos.title: The Eagle and the Osprey
videos.overview: A bank robbery ends in a shooting, giving Sawyer more leverage against Walt. When Henry goes missing, Cady tells Walt about a disturbing vision.

videos.title: Fever
videos.overview: While Henry recuperates, Walt investigates the murder of a man whose land is popular with treasure hunters.

videos.title: Thank You, Victoria
videos.overview: Chance Gilbert's plea appearance takes a dramatic turn that pulls Walt away from his own case and sets him and Vic on the path to a showdown.

videos.title: A Thing I'll Never Understand
videos.overview: An emotional Vic re-examines her life choices. Henry and Jacob join forces to pursue Malachi. Ferg helps Meg's mother avoid the tribal police.

videos.title: Burned Up My Tears
videos.overview: As the civil trial begins, things don't look good for Walt -- especially after a murder puts him and Vic under suspicion.

videos.title: No Greater Character Endorsement
videos.overview: The bizarre death of a drug dealer points to a violent new Hector. Cady tries to help a sick child whose parents don’t trust Western medicine.

videos.title: Opiates and Antibiotics
videos.overview: Walt wonders if a presumed-dead member of the Irish mob is alive. Mathias questions Cady about Catori. A mobile clinic raises Henry's suspicions.

videos.title: Cowboy Bill
videos.overview: While Ferg secretly works the Cowboy Bill case, Walt and Vic try to find Shane Muldoon. Cady's office is trashed.

videos.title: Running Eagle Challenge
videos.overview: Vic gets a surprise visit from her father. An FBI agent helps Walt pin down the mole working with Malachi. A tough race enables Vic to move forward.

videos.title: Goodbye Is Always Implied
videos.overview: Jacob's troubles escalate at the casino. Walt gets an unexpected visitor. An inevitable confrontation leads to changed lives.
